boss_ai.name: Chronos-Omni Rail Core
boss_ai.role: Global Multi-Objective Network Equilibrium & Conflict Arbitration
boss_ai.model_type: Hierarchical Reinforcement Meta-Controller & Graph Neural Network
boss_ai.formula_summary: min L = w1 * TotalDelay + w2 * KineticEnergyLoss + w3 * HeadwayCollisionRisk
boss_ai.math_explanation: Chronos-Omni dynamically synthesizes telemetry from all 3 Leader AIs into a Pareto-optimal action vector. When localized Leader recommendations conflict (e.g. Route Optimizer requests higher speed while Safety Sentinel demands deceleration), Boss AI applies constraint-satisfaction weights with strict safety-first priority invariant (w3 -> infinity on margin breach).

leader_ais.specialization: Dynamic Train Routing, Junction Prioritization & Capacity Management
leader_ais.objective: Minimize network-wide propagation delays across all passenger and freight corridors.
leader_ais.algorithm: Time-Dependent Constrained A* on Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Railway Mesh

leader_ais.name: Safety Interlock Sentinel

leader_ais.objective: Enforce zero collision probability and automatic signal aspect lockdown under physical anomalies.
leader_ais.algorithm: Deterministic Safe-State Machine & Moving Block Headway Geometry

leader_ais.name: Dispatch Neural Hub

leader_ais.objective: Prevent platform gridlock and synchronize passenger boarding with line dispatching.
leader_ais.algorithm: Combinatorial Auction Platform Matcher with Queueing Network Feedback

worker_ais.name: ETA Velocity Forecaster
worker_ais.formula: ETA = sum( d_segment / (v_max * (1 - C_congestion) * (1 - W_weather)) ) + Dwell_Time
worker_ais.explanation: Calculates arrival time for each train down to the second. Divides the remaining journey into 500-meter track segments, calculating the effective velocity accounting for gradient, curve radius, forward block congestion dampening (C_congestion), and weather friction degradation (W_weather).

worker_ais.name: Weather Telemetry Analyzer
worker_ais.assigned_employee_role: AI Module: Environmental Risk & Track Telemetry
worker_ais.formula: W_impact = alpha * Rain_Rate^0.55 + beta * max(0, Wind_Gust - 45) + gamma * (Track_Temp - T_neutral)^1.8
worker_ais.explanation: Computes the adhesion degradation coefficient (friction mu drop from 0.38 down to 0.18 in rain) and track thermal buckling risk. When track temperature exceeds 42C or high crosswinds threaten bridge transit, generates automatic speed reduction mandates (e.g. -18.5%).

worker_ais.name: Track Congestion Predictor
worker_ais.assigned_employee_role: AI Module: Corridor Flow & Bottleneck Analytics
worker_ais.explanation: Uses M/M/c non-linear queuing theory to simulate traffic density 30 minutes into the future. Identifies junction bottlenecks before physical queuing begins and triggers automatic bypass routing recommendations.

worker_ais.name: Signal Pulse Agent
worker_ais.formula: Headway_Safety = d_braking(v, mu) + v * t_comm_latency + d_safety_buffer (min 400m)
worker_ais.explanation: Controls automated aspect transitions (Red -> Yellow -> Double Yellow -> Green). Continuously verifies axle counter pulses and track circuit shunting to ensure no two trains violate moving block safety envelopes.

worker_ais.name: Dynamic Brake & Weight Calc
worker_ais.assigned_employee_role: AI Module: Mechanical Diagnostics & Rolling Stock
worker_ais.explanation: Calculates stopping curves based on real-time axle weight sensors, pad temperature, and track grade. Feeds safe braking curves directly to the Signal Pulse Agent and ETA Forecaster.
